references.text: Jacob bought the plot of land at Shechem from Hamor's sons for a hundred kesitahs, which later became the burial place for Joseph's bones.
Joseph made the Israelites swear that they would carry his bones with them out of Egypt when God came to their aid.
Joseph prophesied that God would lead the Israelites out of Egypt to the land he had promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Moses took Joseph's bones with him when the Israelites left Egypt, in accordance with the oath Joseph had made them swear.
Jacob gave Joseph a plot of land more than his brothers, which he had taken from the Amorites, pointing to Joseph's inheritance at Shechem.
Stephen refers to how Jacob and the fathers were brought back and laid in the tomb that Abraham had bought at Shechem.
In faith, Joseph spoke about the Israelites' departure from Egypt and gave instructions concerning his bones, which were fulfilled when they were buried at Shechem.
